pages.quiz:
INTEGRATED SCIENCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: INTEGRATED SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Curved mirrors? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Curved mirrors.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Curved mirrors.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Curved mirrors.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Curved mirrors.

2. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Milk souring
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Ice melting to water

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Nutrition in animals? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Nutrition in animals.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Nutrition in animals.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Nutrition in animals.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Nutrition in animals.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water hardness? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water hardness.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water hardness.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water hardness.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Water hardness.

5. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Glucose and oxygen

6. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

7. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. watt (W)
   C. joule (J)
   D. newton (N)

8. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Producers
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Tertiary consumers

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying The Interdependence of Life? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on The Interdependence of Life.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about The Interdependence of Life.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to The Interdependence of Life.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for The Interdependence of Life.

10. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 0 °C

11. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Removing all vegetation

12. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Metals and Alloys and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Water hardness and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Nutrition in animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Reproduction in plants and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

1. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Curved mirrors.

2. D — Ice melting to water

3. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Nutrition in animals.

4. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water hardness.

5. D — Glucose and oxygen

6. D — Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

7. D — newton (N)

8. B — Producers

9. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for The Interdependence of Life.

10. A — 100 °C

11. B — Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

12. D — Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
